contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust rosette diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; triangular top to square vexillum with Chi Rho. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.3mm, Weight: 1.17gms,…
